summary.text: Mark Lapka is a Republican state senator from South Dakota's District 23 who took office on January 14, 2025, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as farmer/rancher.

paragraphs.text: Lapka won the 2024 Republican primary for South Dakota State Senate District 23, defeating Steve Roseland 2,279 votes to 1,756, and then won the general election unopposed.
He was assigned to the Senate Appropriations Committee, as vice chair, for the 2025-2026 session.
